encoding: One RGBA 8-bit atlas per grid, phase k at column k % atlas_cols, row k // atlas_cols, each cell nx x nz: R = u east, G = v south, (v/255*2-1)*uscale m/s; B = local water level minus the open-sea level, (v/255*2-1)*escale m; A = 255 wet at that phase (the flats dry and flood). Phase 0 = high water at the open sea, phases evenly through one M2 cycle. Run time: the stream scales with the tidal range of the cycle in progress over the M2 range (currents.js).
model: 2-D shallow-water (continuity + momentum with Manning n = 0.025, Coriolis, upwind advection), explicit C-grid, forced by M2 at the grid edge, 1.0 cycle spin-up; nests take their edge levels from the parent run
sources: NOAA NCEI CUDEM topobathy via terrain.png
NOAA CO-OPS 8413320 Bar Harbor, ME harmonic constituents (tide.json)
